license_required.quote: Any person who provides nursing care to a resident of this state must hold a current license or registration issued by the board.

issuing_authority.quote: Board means the North Dakota board of nursing.

name.quote: Board means the North Dakota board of nursing.

type.quote: There is a state board of nursing whose members must be appointed by the governor which must consist of five registered nurses, one advanced practice registered nurse, two licensed practical nurses, and one public member.

degree_required.quote: Submit an official transcript that verifies completion of a board-approved in-state nursing education program that prepares the graduate for the level of licensure sought

exams.name: Examination approved by the board
exams.quote: Pass an examination approved by the board.

interval_years.quote: The board shall renew a current license to practice as an advanced practice registered nurse, specialty practice registered nurse, registered nurse, or licensed practical nurse if the licensee submits a renewal application, submits the appropriate fee established by the board, and meets all requirements for licensure.

available.quote: Submit evidence of current unencumbered licensure in another state or jurisdiction or meet continued competency requirements as established by the board.

requirements.value: Current unencumbered licensure in another state or jurisdiction, or meet continued competency requirements
requirements.quote: Submit evidence of current unencumbered licensure in another state or jurisdiction or meet continued competency requirements as established by the board.

exists.quote: There is a state board of nursing whose members must be appointed by the governor which must consist of five registered nurses, one advanced practice registered nurse, two licensed practical nurses, and one public member.

regulatory_model.quote: Any person who provides nursing care to a resident of this state must hold a current license or registration issued by the board. It is unlawful for a person to practice nursing, offer to practice nursing, assist in the practice of nursing, or use any title, abbreviation, or designation to indicate that the person is practicing nursing or assisting in the practice of nursing in this state unless that person is currently licensed or registered under this chapter.

credential_type.quote: Any person who provides nursing care to a resident of this state must hold a current license or registration issued by the board.

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for a person to practice nursing, offer to practice nursing, assist in the practice of nursing, or use any title, abbreviation, or designation to indicate that the person is practicing nursing or assisting in the practice of nursing in this state unless that person is currently licensed or registered under this chapter.

title_protection.quote: A person may not use the title "nurse" or be referred to as a "nurse" unless the person is currently licensed by the board or exempt under section 43-12.1-04.

scope_protection.quote: Any person who provides nursing care to a resident of this state must hold a current license or registration issued by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Arrest, charge, or conviction of a crime relating adversely to nursing practice without sufficient rehabilitation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been arrested, charged, or convicted by a court, or has entered a plea of nolo contendere to a crime in any jurisdiction that relates adversely to the practice of nursing and the licensee or registrant has not demonstrated sufficient rehabilitation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplined by another nursing board or had license denied, revoked, suspended, or sanctioned
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been disciplined by a board of nursing in another jurisdiction, or has had a license or registration to practice nursing or to assist in the practice of nursing or to practice in another health care occupation or profession denied, revoked, suspended, or otherwise sanctioned

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in practice inconsistent with standards of nursing practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any practice inconsistent with the standards of nursing practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtained or attempted to obtain license by fraud or deceit, or submitted fraudulent information
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has obtained or attempted to obtain by fraud or deceit a license or registration to practice nursing, or has submitted to the board any information that is fraudulent, deceitful, or false

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in pattern of practice or behavior demonstrating professional misconduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in a pattern of practice or other behavior that demonstrates professional misconduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Diverted or attempted to divert supplies, equipment, drugs, or controlled substances for personal or unauthorized use
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has diverted or attempted to divert supplies, equipment, drugs, or controlled substances for personal use or unauthorized use

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practiced nursing without current license or registration or as otherwise prohibited
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has practiced nursing or assisted in the practice of nursing in this state without a current license or registration or as otherwise prohibited by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to report violations of the chapter or rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to report any violation of this chapter or rules adopted under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to observe and follow board standards, policies, directives, and orders, or violated other provisions of the chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to observe and follow the duly adopted standards, policies, directives, and orders of the board, or has violated any other provision of this chapter

definition_quote.value: The performance of acts utilizing specialized knowledge, skills, and abilities for people in a variety of settings. The term includes: The maintenance of health and prevention of illness; Assessing and diagnosing human responses to actual or potential health problems; Providing supportive and restorative care and nursing treatment, medication administration, health counseling and teaching, case finding and referral of individuals who are ill, injured, or experiencing changes in the normal health processes; Administration, teaching, supervision, delegation, and evaluation of health and nursing practices; Collaboration with other health care professionals in the implementation of the total health care regimen and execution of the health care regimen prescribed by a health care practitioner licensed under the laws of this state.
definition_quote.quote: "Nursing" means the performance of acts utilizing specialized knowledge, skills, and abilities for people in a variety of settings. The term includes the following acts, which may not be deemed to include acts of medical diagnosis or treatment or the practice of medicine as defined in chapter 43-17: a. The maintenance of health and prevention of illness. b. Assessing and diagnosing human responses to actual or potential health problems. c. Providing supportive and restorative care and nursing treatment, medication administration, health counseling and teaching, case finding and referral of individuals who are ill, injured, or experiencing changes in the normal health processes. d. Administration, teaching, supervision, delegation, and evaluation of health and nursing practices. e. Collaboration with other health care professionals in the implementation of the total health care regimen and execution of the health care regimen prescribed by a health care practitioner licensed under the laws of this state.

drug_authority.value: Medication administration and prescriptive practices for advanced practice registered nurses
drug_authority.quote: "Prescriptive practices" means assessing the need for drugs, immunizing agents, or devices and writing a prescription to be filled by a licensed pharmacist.

license_tiers.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse" means an individual who holds a current license to practice in this state as an advanced practice registered nurse within one of the roles of certified nurse practitioner, certified registered nurse anesthetist, certified nurse midwife, or certified clinical nurse specialist... "Specialty practice registered nurse" means an individual who holds a current license to practice in this state as a specialty practice registered nurse and who has current certification from a national certifying body in a specific area of nursing practice... "Registered nurse" means an individual who holds a current license to practice in this state as a registered nurse... "Licensed practical nurse" means an individual who holds a current license to practice in this state as a licensed practical nurse... "Unlicensed assistive person" means an assistant to the nurse, who regardless of title is authorized to perform nursing interventions delegated and supervised by a nurse.

aprn_role_categories.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse" means an individual who holds a current license to practice in this state as an advanced practice registered nurse within one of the roles of certified nurse practitioner, certified registered nurse anesthetist, certified nurse midwife, or certified clinical nurse specialist, and who functions in one of the population foci as approved by the board.

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: "Licensed practical nurse" means an individual who holds a current license to practice in this state as a licensed practical nurse and who practices dependently under the supervision of a registered nurse, specialty practice registered nurse, advanced practice registered nurse, or licensed practitioner.

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: An individual who is registered on the department of health and human services nurse aide registry, including a certified nurse aide, home health aide, nurse aide, and medication assistant.

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: An individual who is registered on the department of health and human services nurse aide registry, including a certified nurse aide, home health aide, nurse aide, and medication assistant.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: A nurse may supervise and delegate nursing interventions to an individual exempt under subsection 13 of section 43-12.1-04.

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: applicants for a multistate license under chapter 43-12.4

multistate_license_option_available.quote: applicants for a multistate license under chapter 43-12.4

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: "Alternative to discipline" means a voluntary alternative to traditional discipline program designed for nurses with substance use disorders, behavioral health conditions, or medical health conditions.
